plain: If your code reads the raw tokens (the tokens export or hirobius.tokens.json), read motion easing from $value.timingFunction and each elevation level and the elastic spring from $extensions["com.hirobius.hds"].$value; CSS variables are unchanged.

steps.plain: The raw tokens (the tokens export and hirobius.tokens.json) are strict DTCG now, so read semantic.motion.*.$value.timingFunction instead of .easing, and the elastic spring and each semantic.elevation level from $extensions["com.hirobius.hds"].$value.
--component-tag-lineHeight is now 1.5 instead of an invalid value the browser ignored, so text that reads it gets that line height.
